reviews.title: Functions that we needed as a premium user!
reviews.text:
The app would really benefit from a refresh of the map UI and overall theme. The current design still feels outdated, and the newer theme does not yet cover all map elements. There is also limited 3D detail for buildings and surroundings. A more modern and visually detailed experience, similar to Google Maps, would greatly improve Sygic.

Another important issue is the backup and synchronisation of favourites. Saved locations should reliably sync across devices using the same Apple ID. I installed Sygic on my iPad, but none of my favourites from my iPhone appeared, despite iCloud backup being enabled.

Please also add custom categories for Favourites. Instead of being limited to predefined categories such as Free Time, Travel, and Friends & Family, users should be able to create, rename and manage their own categories.

As a Premium user who regularly relies on Sygic, I would really appreciate a modernised map design, better 3D visuals, proper cross device favourites sync, custom favourite categories, and the return of the previous arrival sound.

reviews.title: Really close to being great
reviews.text:
I switched to Sygic from Waze because of how awful it is with no or particularly low signal. It will try and route and just timeout even though it is capable of routing with no signal. Sygic on the other hand will route first and get traffic data later which is incredible. Its routing is also fantastic and it is almost militaristic in trying to stop me waiting in traffic.  With that said it has two downsides that have dropped it to two stars for me. Firstly, searching for your destination is not great. Unless you have an address finding somewhere by its name is not very easy. The second and much bigger problem is the constant advertisements for you to pay more money. The initial subscription is absolutely reasonable but I do not need to navigate as a campervan or motorbike. I wouldn’t even mind unobtrusive ads but literally everytime you open the app despite the fact you’ve paid for premium, you still get an ad! 

It’s also worth noting my account has a separate issue with syncing. I’m unsure of the cause but I was advised the only way to resolve was to delete my account. The problem means if I turn sync on it overwrites my home address with old data.

reviews.title: Late lane guidance & thinks A406 is motorway!!!
reviews.text:
Lane guidance before turns or roundabouts currently appears very late, often at around 20 yards. At that point, it is difficult for the driver to safely react or change lanes. For comparison, Google Maps typically provides this guidance at approximately 0.3 miles in advance, which allows much more comfortable preparation time.

I do appreciate the lane panel feature in Sygic—it is visually clear and very helpful. However, its usefulness would be significantly improved if the guidance appeared earlier. A possible improvement would be to show an advance notice (e.g., “Lane guidance in 0.3 miles ahead”), similar to how Google Maps and Waze provide early preparation alerts.

Additionally, it would be beneficial if the lane panel remained visible for longer. Currently, it appears quite late and disappears quickly. Keeping the lane panel visible throughout the approach to the junction would make it a much more practical and valuable feature.

Overall, the lane panel is an excellent feature, but earlier notifications and longer on-screen visibility would greatly enhance the user experience and driving safety

reviews.title: Gone Downhill
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for the last year or so and it’s gradually been going downhill big time. The lack of customisation for your vehicle and the appearance is quite annoying but more importantly they’ve programmed it with features that are more or less gimmicks. Nobody is gonna be driving with the phone stuck on their dashboard which is gonna fly off in an accident or harsh breaking just to use the head up display gimmick. Secondly, most people already have a dash cam I don’t rely on their mobile phone navigation app to provide this.

Instead, features that should work properly don’t. I paid for the premium version and still can’t get petrol prices on the map only the petrol station name which kind of defeats the object of having the premium version. The last straw today was when the premium subscription ran out and I then subsequently found out that I can’t even use CarPlay now without a premium. So that’s the nail in the coffin for me and it’s now being deleted and I’m using an alternative supply for my maps as I can’t see any advantages anymore in having Sygic navigation.

reviews.title: Don’t buy it
reviews.text: Don’t buy this GPS app, it’s horrible!!! When I tried to get my money back, they blocked the option. Use Google Maps—it’s free. The app confuses streets and stores!! It’s a mess

reviews.title: Fundamental Flaw
reviews.text:
Been using this app for years. Paying customer for last several. 
I live remotely in Wyoming and work remotely in WY and MT. This is the only app that shows marked state trails without having to use another specialized app. 

Being remote means what?  No cell service. There is no cell service in Wyoming that covers the state. Nor in Montana. 

Here’s the flaw that needs to be fixed. If you are not logged in, ie lost cell service and did a reset on your phone, offline maps are not available until you log back in again. Need service to do that. 

Please put an imbedded identifier in the programming that if someone that pays for the app is automatically recognized without having to log in to access ie recognize that offline maps are available and have already been downloaded. 

Trying being remote 70 plus miles from any paved road and there is no access to downloaded maps because you can’t log in.

And it sucks to be told before using please download a map when you have maps downloaded.

reviews.title: I used to like this app, Now I hate it
reviews.text: When it works it’s ok, but when things go wrong there’s no fixing it. The app isn’t allowing me to select or download my offline state. I have repeatedly set to default as per instructions but it goes back to what it was. I’m done with it. There’s too much competition in this space to pay for non functioning troublesome apps.

reviews.title: Terrible GPS option
reviews.text: They want you to pay for a subscription and limit all options unless you pay for a worthless subscription when the competition offers all features for free.

reviews.title: Used to be great, now just another subscription trap
reviews.text:
I've been using this app on and off for years, and it used to be my go-to GPS solution. I even purchased the "Premium Plus" lifetime license a few years ago to support the developers and avoid recurring costs.
Unfortunately, the app has gone completely downhill. Upon opening it recently, I found my lifetime license is being ignored, and the only options available are expensive yearly subscriptions. There is no longer an option to buy the app outright. It is deeply disappointing to see yet another useful tool switch to a greedy subscription-based model, essentially revoking the purchase I already paid for. If you are a legacy user, beware: your past investment means nothing here.
